q18850.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of uneven road ahead.

explain.short: The wavy line shows a damaged, bumpy road surface: this is the 'strada deformata' (uneven road) sign.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'deformata' means bent out of shape: here, an uneven road surface.

sceneParams.caption: Uneven road ahead: slow down

q18851.en: The sign shown can be paired with a maximum speed limit sign.

explain.short: A speed limit is often added under this sign, so that drivers cross the bumpy stretch slowly.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'può essere' means 'can be': it is allowed, not compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: It can come with a speed limit sign

q18852.en: The sign shown indicates a stretch of uneven road 380 metres long.

explain.short: The panel with arrows pointing up gives the LENGTH of the danger: the uneven road lasts 380 m.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: A panel with arrows ('↑380m↑') is a length; a panel without arrows is a distance.

sceneParams.caption: Arrows on the panel = the stretch is 380 m long

q18853.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road with an irregular surface.

explain.short: An uneven road has an irregular surface, with bumps and holes: this is what the sign warns of.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'pavimentazione irregolare' (irregular surface) is another way to say 'strada deformata'.

sceneParams.caption: Irregular road surface ahead

q18854.en: The sign shown warns of a road in bad condition.

explain.short: A damaged, bumpy road is a road in bad condition: the sign warns of exactly this.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'cattivo stato' (bad condition) is a correct description of the uneven road.

sceneParams.caption: Road in bad condition ahead

q18855.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: Red-edged triangle with the point up: all signs with this shape are danger signs.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: The triangle shape gives it away: 'pericolo' means danger.

sceneParams.caption: Red triangle = danger sign

q18856.en: The sign shown is, as a rule, placed 150 metres before a stretch of road with an irregular surface.

explain.short: Outside towns, danger signs are normally placed about 150 m before the danger, to give you time to slow down.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'in genere' (as a rule) allows exceptions, so the statement is correct.

sceneParams.caption: About 150 m before the bumpy stretch

q18857.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of damaged road.

explain.short: 'Dissestata' means broken up, damaged: the same idea as an uneven road.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'dissestata' (damaged, broken up) is a synonym of 'deformata' here.

sceneParams.caption: Damaged road ahead

q18858.en: The sign shown, if on a yellow background, is used where there are roadworks.

explain.short: Danger signs with a yellow background are temporary signs used at roadworks (cantieri).
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'se a fondo giallo' (if yellow background): yellow means temporary, for roadworks.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow background = temporary, for roadworks

q18859.en: The sign shown is a prescription sign.

explain.short: It is a triangle, so it is a danger sign. Prescription signs (orders and bans) are mostly round.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' (prescription) means orders and bans: not this triangle.

sceneParams.caption: It is a DANGER sign, not a prescription sign

q18860.en: The sign shown warns of a dangerous descent.

explain.short: A dangerous descent has its own sign with a sloping line and a percentage. This sign shows a wavy, bumpy surface.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: It warns of an uneven road, not a descent

q18861.en: The sign shown warns of several bends in a row.

explain.short: Several bends are shown with a zig-zag arrow. Here the line is horizontal and bumpy: an uneven road.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'più curve consecutive' (several bends in a row) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Uneven road, not a series of bends

q18862.en: The sign shown warns of a series of humps.

explain.short: A hump (dosso) sign shows ONE rounded bump. This sign shows an irregular, wavy surface: uneven road.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'serie di dossi' (series of humps) sounds close, but the sign is 'strada deformata'.

sceneParams.caption: Uneven road, not a series of humps

q18863.en: The sign shown warns of a sharp change in the slope of the road.

explain.short: A change of slope is a hump or a dip. This sign is about a bumpy surface, not a slope.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'variazione di pendenza' (change of slope) describes the hump, not this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Bumpy surface, not a change of slope

q18864.en: The sign shown warns of a double bend.

explain.short: A double bend is shown with an S-shaped arrow. Here there is no arrow, only a bumpy line.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'doppia curva' (double bend) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Uneven road, not a double bend

q18865.en: The sign shown warns of a hump.

explain.short: The hump (dosso) sign has one smooth bump. This one has a wavy, irregular line: uneven road.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'dosso' (hump) is the sign most often confused with this one.

sceneParams.caption: Uneven road, not a hump

q18866.en: The sign shown warns of a dip or a hump.

explain.short: Dip (cunetta) and hump (dosso) have their own signs. This one shows a bumpy surface: uneven road.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'cunetta o un dosso' (dip or hump): neither is right.

sceneParams.caption: Uneven road, not a dip or a hump

q18867.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road with limited visibility.

explain.short: Limited visibility is typical of a hump or a bend. This sign warns of a bad surface, not of poor view.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: 'visibilità limitata' (limited visibility) belongs to the hump sign.

sceneParams.caption: Bad surface, not limited visibility

q18868.en: The sign shown indicates a stretch of uneven road 320 metres long.

explain.short: The panel has NO arrows, so 320 m is the DISTANCE to the uneven road, not its length.
explain.rule: 'Strada deformata' (uneven road) is a danger sign, about 150 m before a damaged or irregular road surface.
explain.trap: Without arrows, '320 m' is a distance ('the danger starts in 320 m'), not a length.

sceneParams.caption: No arrows: the danger starts in 320 m

q18869.en: Where you see the sign shown, it is important to expect possible skidding of vehicles coming the other way.

explain.short: On a bumpy road any vehicle can lose grip or swerve, also those coming towards you. Be ready for it.
explain.rule: On an uneven road slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect skids, also from oncoming cars.
explain.trap: 'senso opposto' means the opposite direction: oncoming traffic.

sceneParams.caption: Oncoming cars may skid on the bumps

q18870.en: Where you see the sign shown, you must adjust your speed to the particular condition of the road surface.

explain.short: The surface is damaged, so your speed must suit it: slower where it is worse.
explain.rule: On an uneven road slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect skids, also from oncoming cars.
explain.trap: 'adeguare' means adjust: speed must fit the surface.

sceneParams.caption: Adjust speed to the bad surface

q18871.en: Where you see the sign shown, you must drive at a moderate speed if you are towing a trailer.

explain.short: A trailer bounces a lot on bumps and can sway: drive slowly.
explain.rule: On an uneven road slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect skids, also from oncoming cars.
explain.trap: 'se si traina un rimorchio' (if towing a trailer) adds a case where slowing is even more needed.

sceneParams.caption: With a trailer: drive slowly on bumps

q18872.en: Where you see the sign shown, you must slow down to avoid excessive stress and damage to the suspension.

explain.short: Driving fast over bumps hits the suspension hard and can damage it. Slowing down protects the car.
explain.rule: On an uneven road slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect skids, also from oncoming cars.
explain.trap: 'sospensioni' (suspension) is the part of the car that absorbs bumps.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down to save the suspension

q18873.en: Where you see the sign shown, you must hold the steering wheel firmly to control possible skids.

explain.short: Bumps can jerk the steering wheel. A firm grip keeps the car under control.
explain.rule: On an uneven road slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect skids, also from oncoming cars.
explain.trap: 'saldamente' means firmly.

sceneParams.caption: Hold the wheel firmly on bumps

q18874.en: Where you see the sign shown, you must drive in the centre of the carriageway.

explain.short: A danger sign gives no order about your position. You keep to the right as always.
explain.rule: On an uneven road slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect skids, also from oncoming cars.
explain.trap: 'obbligatorio' (compulsory): a danger sign creates no such duty.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down, but keep to the right

keywords.en: in the centre of the carriageway

q18875.en: Where you see the sign shown, you do not need to slow down in poor visibility.

explain.short: Poor visibility plus a bad surface is double danger: you must slow down even more.
explain.rule: On an uneven road slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect skids, also from oncoming cars.
explain.trap: 'non è necessario' (not necessary) is the trap: slowing down IS needed.

sceneParams.caption: Poor visibility + bumps: slow down even more

q18876.en: Where you see the sign shown, you must watch out for the carriageway narrowing.

explain.short: A narrowing has its own sign (strettoia). This sign is about a bumpy surface.
explain.rule: On an uneven road slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect skids, also from oncoming cars.
explain.trap: 'restringimento' (narrowing) is a different danger.

sceneParams.caption: Bumpy surface, not a narrowing

q18877.en: Where you see the sign shown, overtaking is forbidden.

explain.short: A danger sign does not ban overtaking. Only a no-overtaking sign or other rules (bends, humps...) do.
explain.rule: On an uneven road slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect skids, also from oncoming cars.
explain.trap: 'vietato' (forbidden): this sign forbids nothing.

sceneParams.caption: No overtaking ban: just slow down

q18878.en: Where you see the sign shown, you must slow down only if vehicles are coming the other way.

explain.short: You slow down because of the bad surface, always, with or without oncoming traffic.
explain.rule: On an uneven road slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect skids, also from oncoming cars.
explain.trap: 'solo se' (only if) wrongly limits a duty that always applies.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down always, not only for oncoming cars

q18879.en: The sign shown warns of a hump.

explain.short: One smooth black bump: this is the 'dosso' (hump) sign, a short rise and fall of the road.
explain.rule: 'Dosso' (hump) is a danger sign: the road goes up and down and you cannot see beyond the top.
explain.trap: 'dosso' means hump: a road that goes up and then down.

sceneParams.caption: Hump ahead: slow down

q18880.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road that is dangerous because of limited visibility.

explain.short: On a hump you cannot see past the top: what comes from the other side is hidden.
explain.rule: 'Dosso' (hump) is a danger sign: the road goes up and down and you cannot see beyond the top.
explain.trap: 'limitata visibilità' (limited visibility) is exactly the danger of a hump.

sceneParams.caption: You cannot see past the top of the hump

q18881.en: The sign shown is, as a rule, placed 150 metres before a hump.

explain.short: Outside towns, danger signs normally stand 150 m before the danger.
explain.rule: 'Dosso' (hump) is a danger sign: the road goes up and down and you cannot see beyond the top.
explain.trap: 'di norma' (as a rule) allows exceptions: correct.

sceneParams.caption: As a rule, 150 m before the hump

q18882.en: Where you see the sign shown, you must consider that visibility is limited.

explain.short: The top of the hump hides the road beyond it, so you see less than usual.
explain.rule: 'Dosso' (hump) is a danger sign: the road goes up and down and you cannot see beyond the top.
explain.trap: 'considerare' means keep in mind: plan for poor visibility.

sceneParams.caption: Visibility is limited at the hump

q18883.en: The sign shown warns of a climb followed by a descent.

explain.short: A hump is exactly this: the road goes up, then down.
explain.rule: 'Dosso' (hump) is a danger sign: the road goes up and down and you cannot see beyond the top.
explain.trap: 'salita, seguita da una discesa' (up, then down) is the hump; the dip is the opposite.

sceneParams.caption: Hump = up, then down

q18884.en: The sign shown warns of a change in the slope of the road with limited visibility.

explain.short: A hump is a change of slope (up then down) where you cannot see past the top.
explain.rule: 'Dosso' (hump) is a danger sign: the road goes up and down and you cannot see beyond the top.
explain.trap: 'variazione di pendenza' (change of slope) plus limited visibility = hump.

sceneParams.caption: Change of slope with poor view: the hump

q18885.en: The sign shown warns of a dip.

explain.short: A dip (cunetta) goes down then up, and its sign has a line that sinks. This bump goes UP: it is a hump.
explain.rule: 'Dosso' (hump) is a danger sign: the road goes up and down and you cannot see beyond the top.
explain.trap: 'cunetta' (dip) is the opposite of 'dosso' (hump).

sceneParams.caption: Hump (up), not a dip (down)

q18886.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of uneven road.

explain.short: Uneven road has a wavy line. This sign has one smooth bump: a hump.
explain.rule: 'Dosso' (hump) is a danger sign: the road goes up and down and you cannot see beyond the top.
explain.trap: 'strada deformata' (uneven road) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Hump, not uneven road

q18887.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road in bad condition.

explain.short: A road in bad condition is shown by the uneven-road sign. This is the hump sign.
explain.rule: 'Dosso' (hump) is a danger sign: the road goes up and down and you cannot see beyond the top.
explain.trap: 'cattivo stato' (bad condition) belongs to the uneven-road sign.

sceneParams.caption: Hump, not a road in bad condition

q18888.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road with an irregular surface.

explain.short: An irregular surface is the uneven-road sign. The hump is about slope and visibility.
explain.rule: 'Dosso' (hump) is a danger sign: the road goes up and down and you cannot see beyond the top.
explain.trap: 'pavimentazione irregolare' (irregular surface) is the uneven-road sign.

sceneParams.caption: Hump, not an irregular surface

q18889.en: The sign shown warns of a bridge.

explain.short: No sign in this family means 'bridge'. The bump shows a hump in the road.
explain.rule: 'Dosso' (hump) is a danger sign: the road goes up and down and you cannot see beyond the top.
explain.trap: 'ponte' (bridge): the rounded shape may look like one, but it is a hump.

sceneParams.caption: Hump, not a bridge

q18890.en: The sign shown warns of roadworks.

explain.short: Roadworks have their own sign, with a person digging. This is the hump sign.
explain.rule: 'Dosso' (hump) is a danger sign: the road goes up and down and you cannot see beyond the top.
explain.trap: 'lavori in corso' (roadworks) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Hump, not roadworks

q18891.en: The sign shown warns of the entrance to a tunnel.

explain.short: A tunnel has a different sign. The black shape here is a hump on the road.
explain.rule: 'Dosso' (hump) is a danger sign: the road goes up and down and you cannot see beyond the top.
explain.trap: 'galleria' (tunnel): the shape is not a tunnel opening.

sceneParams.caption: Hump, not a tunnel

q18892.en: Where you see the sign shown, you must reduce your speed according to the visibility.

explain.short: You cannot see beyond the top, so drive at a speed that lets you stop within what you see.
explain.rule: At a hump: no U-turn, no stopping or parking, no overtaking uphill on a two-lane two-way road.
explain.trap: 'in relazione alla visibilità' means speed must match how far you can see.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down: you can't see over the top

q18893.en: Where you see the sign shown, U-turns are forbidden.

explain.short: Turning round on a hump is very dangerous: drivers coming over the top cannot see you. The law forbids it.
explain.rule: At a hump: no U-turn, no stopping or parking, no overtaking uphill on a two-lane two-way road.
explain.trap: 'inversione di marcia' means a U-turn.

sceneParams.caption: No U-turns on a hump

q18894.en: Where you see the sign shown, stopping and parking are forbidden on both the uphill and the downhill stretch.

explain.short: A car standing on a hump is hidden from those coming over the top, on either side. Stopping and parking are both forbidden.
explain.rule: At a hump: no U-turn, no stopping or parking, no overtaking uphill on a two-lane two-way road.
explain.trap: 'sia ... che' (both ... and): the ban covers both sides of the hump.

sceneParams.caption: No stopping or parking on either side

q18895.en: Where you see the sign shown, overtaking is forbidden on the uphill stretch, if the road is two-way with only two lanes.

explain.short: Going up, you cannot see oncoming traffic beyond the top. On a two-lane two-way road you would end up on their side.
explain.rule: At a hump: no U-turn, no stopping or parking, no overtaking uphill on a two-lane two-way road.
explain.trap: Both conditions matter: 'in salita' (uphill) and 'due sole corsie' (only two lanes).

sceneParams.caption: No overtaking uphill on a two-lane road

q18896.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: It is a red-edged triangle pointing up: a danger sign.
explain.rule: At a hump: no U-turn, no stopping or parking, no overtaking uphill on a two-lane two-way road.
explain.trap: 'pericolo' (danger): the triangle shape tells you.

sceneParams.caption: Red triangle = danger sign

q18897.en: The sign shown can warn of artificial humps.

explain.short: The same sign is used before speed humps built on purpose to slow traffic.
explain.rule: At a hump: no U-turn, no stopping or parking, no overtaking uphill on a two-lane two-way road.
explain.trap: 'dossi artificiali' (artificial humps) = speed bumps; 'può' means can.

sceneParams.caption: Also used before speed bumps

explain.short: It is a danger sign: it bans nobody. A ban on buses is a round sign with a bus.
explain.rule: At a hump: no U-turn, no stopping or parking, no overtaking uphill on a two-lane two-way road.
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito' (bans): danger signs do not ban.

sceneParams.caption: A danger sign: it bans nobody

q18899.en: Where you see the sign shown, overtaking is forbidden on the downhill stretch.

explain.short: After the top you can see the road ahead again, so this sign does not forbid overtaking on the way down.
explain.rule: At a hump: no U-turn, no stopping or parking, no overtaking uphill on a two-lane two-way road.
explain.trap: 'in discesa' (downhill): the ban is only for the uphill side.

sceneParams.caption: Downhill you can see again: no ban here

q18900.en: The sign shown is a mandatory sign.

explain.short: Mandatory signs are blue circles. This red triangle is a danger sign.
explain.rule: At a hump: no U-turn, no stopping or parking, no overtaking uphill on a two-lane two-way road.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' (mandatory): blue circle, not a triangle.

sceneParams.caption: Danger sign, not mandatory

q18901.en: Where you see the sign shown, you may make a U-turn on the downhill stretch.

explain.short: U-turns are forbidden on the whole hump, downhill too: a car turning there is a danger.
explain.rule: At a hump: no U-turn, no stopping or parking, no overtaking uphill on a two-lane two-way road.
explain.trap: 'è possibile' (it is allowed) is wrong: no U-turns anywhere on a hump.

sceneParams.caption: No U-turn on the hump, downhill too

q18902.en: The sign shown is a priority sign.

explain.short: Priority signs (give way, STOP, priority road) look different. This triangle is a danger sign.
explain.rule: At a hump: no U-turn, no stopping or parking, no overtaking uphill on a two-lane two-way road.
explain.trap: 'precedenza' (priority / right of way): not this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Danger sign, not a priority sign

q18903.en: The sign shown warns of a dip.

explain.short: The black line sinks in the middle: this is the 'cunetta' (dip) sign, where the road goes down and up.
explain.rule: 'Cunetta' (dip) is a danger sign: the road goes down and then up, and water can collect there.
explain.trap: 'cunetta' means dip: the opposite of a hump.

sceneParams.caption: Dip ahead: slow down

q18904.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road that is dangerous because of a dip.

explain.short: The sign shows a dip, and it warns that this stretch is dangerous.
explain.rule: 'Cunetta' (dip) is a danger sign: the road goes down and then up, and water can collect there.
explain.trap: 'a causa di una cunetta' (because of a dip) names the right danger.

sceneParams.caption: Danger: a dip in the road

q18905.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: Red-edged triangle pointing up: a danger sign.
explain.rule: 'Cunetta' (dip) is a danger sign: the road goes down and then up, and water can collect there.
explain.trap: 'pericolo' (danger): the triangle shape tells you.

sceneParams.caption: Red triangle = danger sign

q18906.en: The sign shown is placed before a downhill stretch followed by an uphill one.

explain.short: A dip is exactly this: the road goes down, then up again.
explain.rule: 'Cunetta' (dip) is a danger sign: the road goes down and then up, and water can collect there.
explain.trap: 'discesa seguito da uno in salita' (down, then up) = dip; the hump is the opposite.

sceneParams.caption: Dip = down, then up

q18907.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road that could flood in heavy rain.

explain.short: Water runs to the lowest point, so the bottom of a dip can fill with water when it rains hard.
explain.rule: 'Cunetta' (dip) is a danger sign: the road goes down and then up, and water can collect there.
explain.trap: 'allagarsi' means to flood.

sceneParams.caption: The bottom of a dip can flood

q18908.en: The sign shown indicates a soft verge.

explain.short: A soft verge (banchina cedevole) has its own sign with a car tilting at the edge. This is a dip.
explain.rule: 'Cunetta' (dip) is a danger sign: the road goes down and then up, and water can collect there.
explain.trap: 'banchina cedevole' (soft verge) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Dip, not a soft verge

q18909.en: The sign shown warns of an uneven road.

explain.short: Uneven road has a wavy line. Here the line sinks once: a dip.
explain.rule: 'Cunetta' (dip) is a danger sign: the road goes down and then up, and water can collect there.
explain.trap: 'strada deformata' (uneven road) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Dip, not uneven road

q18910.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road in bad condition.

explain.short: A road in bad condition is the uneven-road sign. This one is a dip.
explain.rule: 'Cunetta' (dip) is a danger sign: the road goes down and then up, and water can collect there.
explain.trap: 'cattivo stato' (bad condition) belongs to the uneven-road sign.

sceneParams.caption: Dip, not a road in bad condition

q18911.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road with an irregular surface.

explain.short: An irregular surface is the uneven-road sign. The dip is about the shape of the road.
explain.rule: 'Cunetta' (dip) is a danger sign: the road goes down and then up, and water can collect there.
explain.trap: 'pavimentazione irregolare' (irregular surface) is the uneven-road sign.

sceneParams.caption: Dip, not an irregular surface

q18912.en: The sign shown can be placed before an uphill stretch followed by a descent.

explain.short: Up then down is a hump (dosso). A dip is the opposite: down, then up.
explain.rule: 'Cunetta' (dip) is a danger sign: the road goes down and then up, and water can collect there.
explain.trap: 'salita seguito da una discesa' (up, then down) describes the hump, not the dip.

sceneParams.caption: Dip = down then up (not up then down)

q18913.en: The sign shown warns of a narrowing of the carriageway.

explain.short: A narrowing (strettoia) has its own sign with two lines getting closer. This is a dip.
explain.rule: 'Cunetta' (dip) is a danger sign: the road goes down and then up, and water can collect there.
explain.trap: 'restringimento' (narrowing) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Dip, not a narrowing

q18914.en: The sign shown warns of a hump.

explain.short: The hump's line goes UP. Here the line goes DOWN: it is a dip.
explain.rule: 'Cunetta' (dip) is a danger sign: the road goes down and then up, and water can collect there.
explain.trap: 'dosso' (hump) is the opposite of 'cunetta' (dip).

sceneParams.caption: Dip (down), not a hump (up)

q18915.en: Where you see the sign shown, you must slow down to avoid damage to the suspension.

explain.short: Hitting the bottom of a dip fast gives the suspension a hard knock. Slowing down protects it.
explain.rule: At a dip slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect water, mud or debris at the bottom.
explain.trap: 'sospensioni' (suspension) is the part that absorbs bumps.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down to save the suspension

q18916.en: Where you see the sign shown, you must slow down to keep control of the vehicle.

explain.short: A fast dip can make the car bounce and lose grip. At low speed you stay in control.
explain.rule: At a dip slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect water, mud or debris at the bottom.
explain.trap: 'controllo del veicolo' (control of the vehicle) is the reason to slow down.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down to keep control

q18917.en: Where you see the sign shown, you must hold the steering wheel with a firmer grip.

explain.short: The dip can jolt the car and the steering. A firm grip keeps you in control.
explain.rule: At a dip slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect water, mud or debris at the bottom.
explain.trap: 'presa più sicura' means a firmer grip.

sceneParams.caption: Hold the wheel firmly in the dip

q18918.en: Where you see the sign shown, in rain you must expect water to collect in the dip.

explain.short: Rain water runs to the lowest point: the bottom of the dip. Expect puddles or flooding.
explain.rule: At a dip slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect water, mud or debris at the bottom.
explain.trap: 'accumulo di acqua' means water collecting.

sceneParams.caption: Rain: water collects in the dip

q18919.en: Where you see the sign shown, you must expect mud and debris to collect in the dip.

explain.short: Rain carries mud, stones and debris down to the lowest point of the dip.
explain.rule: At a dip slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect water, mud or debris at the bottom.
explain.trap: 'fango e detriti' means mud and debris.

sceneParams.caption: Mud and debris can collect in the dip

q18920.en: Where you see the sign shown, you must slow down only if vehicles are coming the other way.

explain.short: You slow down because of the dip itself, always, even with no oncoming traffic.
explain.rule: At a dip slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect water, mud or debris at the bottom.
explain.trap: 'solo se' (only if) wrongly limits a duty that always applies.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down always, not only for oncoming cars

q18921.en: Where you see the sign shown, you do not need to slow down if the dip is visible.

explain.short: Even if you can see the dip, it still shakes the car: you must slow down anyway.
explain.rule: At a dip slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect water, mud or debris at the bottom.
explain.trap: 'non è necessario' (not necessary) is the trap: slowing down is always needed.

sceneParams.caption: Visible or not, slow down for the dip

q18922.en: Where you see the sign shown, overtaking is forbidden if you are on a one-way road.

explain.short: This danger sign forbids nothing, and on a one-way road nobody comes towards you.
explain.rule: At a dip slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect water, mud or debris at the bottom.
explain.trap: 'vietato' (forbidden): this sign creates no ban.

sceneParams.caption: No overtaking ban: just slow down

q18923.en: The sign shown warns of a soft verge.

explain.short: A soft verge has its own sign. This one shows a dip in the road.
explain.rule: At a dip slow down, hold the wheel firmly and expect water, mud or debris at the bottom.
explain.trap: 'banchina cedevole' (soft verge) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: Dip, not a soft verge

q18924.en: The sign shown warns of a dangerous bend to the right.

explain.short: The black arrow bends to the right: one dangerous bend to the right.
explain.rule: 'Curva pericolosa a destra' warns of one dangerous right bend, as a rule 150 m before it: slow down.
explain.trap: 'a destra' (to the right): check the direction of the arrow.

sceneParams.caption: Dangerous right bend: slow down

q18925.en: The sign shown is, as a rule, placed 150 metres from the start of the bend.

explain.short: Outside towns, danger signs normally stand 150 m before the danger.
explain.rule: 'Curva pericolosa a destra' warns of one dangerous right bend, as a rule 150 m before it: slow down.
explain.trap: 'di norma' (as a rule) allows exceptions: correct.

sceneParams.caption: As a rule, 150 m before the bend

q18926.en: The sign shown can be completed with a panel saying TORNANTE.

explain.short: When the bend is a hairpin, a panel with the word TORNANTE (hairpin bend) is added under the sign.
explain.rule: 'Curva pericolosa a destra' warns of one dangerous right bend, as a rule 150 m before it: slow down.
explain.trap: 'tornante' means hairpin bend; 'può' means it can, not that it must.

sceneParams.caption: A TORNANTE panel can be added

q18927.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road that is dangerous because of reduced visibility.

explain.short: In a bend you cannot see far ahead: what is after the bend is hidden.
explain.rule: 'Curva pericolosa a destra' warns of one dangerous right bend, as a rule 150 m before it: slow down.
explain.trap: 'ridotta visibilità' (reduced visibility) is a real danger of bends.

sceneParams.caption: In a bend you can't see far

q18928.en: The sign shown requires you to reduce your speed.

explain.short: Every danger sign asks you to be careful and slow down so you can take the bend safely.
explain.rule: 'Curva pericolosa a destra' warns of one dangerous right bend, as a rule 150 m before it: slow down.
explain.trap: 'richiede' (requires): slowing down is expected at every danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down before the bend

q18929.en: The sign shown warns of a dangerous stretch of road.

explain.short: It is a danger sign: it warns of a dangerous stretch, here a bend.
explain.rule: 'Curva pericolosa a destra' warns of one dangerous right bend, as a rule 150 m before it: slow down.
explain.trap: 'pericoloso' (dangerous) is true for every danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Danger ahead: a bend

q18930.en: The sign shown warns of a series of dangerous bends, the first one to the right.

explain.short: A series of bends is shown with a double, S-shaped arrow. This arrow bends only once.
explain.rule: 'Curva pericolosa a destra' warns of one dangerous right bend, as a rule 150 m before it: slow down.
explain.trap: 'serie di curve' (series of bends) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: One bend only, not a series

keywords.en: the first one to the right

q18931.en: The sign shown announces that you must turn right.

explain.short: A compulsory turn is a blue round sign. This triangle only warns that the road bends.
explain.rule: 'Curva pericolosa a destra' warns of one dangerous right bend, as a rule 150 m before it: slow down.
explain.trap: 'obbligo di svolta' (compulsory turn) is a mandatory sign, not a danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: The road bends: no order to turn

q18932.en: The sign shown is a prescription sign.

explain.short: It is a triangle, so it is a danger sign. Prescription signs give orders and bans.
explain.rule: 'Curva pericolosa a destra' warns of one dangerous right bend, as a rule 150 m before it: slow down.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' (prescription) means orders and bans: not this triangle.

sceneParams.caption: Danger sign, not prescription

q18933.en: The sign shown warns of an uphill stretch of road.

explain.short: A steep climb has its own sign with a slope and a percentage. This arrow shows a bend.
explain.rule: 'Curva pericolosa a destra' warns of one dangerous right bend, as a rule 150 m before it: slow down.
explain.trap: 'in salita' (uphill): the arrow shows a bend, not a slope.

sceneParams.caption: A bend, not a climb

q18934.en: The sign shown warns of a lane change.

explain.short: A lane change has a different sign. This arrow is a bend in the road.
explain.rule: 'Curva pericolosa a destra' warns of one dangerous right bend, as a rule 150 m before it: slow down.
explain.trap: 'cambio di corsia' (lane change) is a different sign.

sceneParams.caption: A bend, not a lane change

q18935.en: The sign shown warns of a bend to the left.

explain.short: The arrow bends to the RIGHT. A left bend sign has the arrow bending left.
explain.rule: 'Curva pericolosa a destra' warns of one dangerous right bend, as a rule 150 m before it: slow down.
explain.trap: 'a sinistra' (to the left): look at the arrow, it goes right.

sceneParams.caption: Bend to the RIGHT, not left

q18936.en: The sign shown, placed on a two-way road, requires you to move to the left side of the carriageway to take the bend better.

explain.short: You must always keep to the right, especially in a bend with poor visibility. Moving left means meeting oncoming cars.
explain.rule: 'Curva pericolosa a destra' warns of one dangerous right bend, as a rule 150 m before it: slow down.
explain.trap: 'impone' (requires): the sign never orders you to go left.

sceneParams.caption: Keep right in the bend, never cut left

q18937.en: The sign shown is, as a rule, placed 5 metres from the start of the bend.

explain.short: 5 m is far too short to slow down. Outside towns danger signs stand about 150 m before the danger.
explain.rule: 'Curva pericolosa a destra' warns of one dangerous right bend, as a rule 150 m before it: slow down.
explain.trap: '5 metri' is the wrong number: the rule is 150 m.

sceneParams.caption: 150 m before the bend, not 5 m
